blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Eighteen untoward incidents were reported nd recorded across Oriental Mindoro during the Undas season, according to the Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO). Fifteen vehicular accidents, one maritime incident and two cases involving injured or ill individuals were logged from October 30 to November 2, the PDRRMO reported in its Situation Report No. 12 issued at 11 a.m. on Monday. Puerto Galera had the most number of incidents with four, followed by Naujan town with three.
